newsitem.title: INDIA: Low export interest cuts Indian castor prices.
newsitem.headline: Low export interest cuts Indian castor prices.

text.p: Indian castor prices fell on Friday to 1,140 rupees per quintal from 1,149 rupees on fresh speculative offerings and low export interest, dealers said.
They said new crop arrivals were expected in second half October. "Overall, sentiment was subdued and traders were expecting a further fall on low volumes," one dealer said.
Groundnut oil fell to 414/415 rupees per 10 kg from 420/422 on improved new crop arrivals. In Rajkot spot oil fell by 5/10 rupees to 655/660 rupees per 15 kg.
"Higher supplies of imported palm oil also dragged down groundnut oil prices," the dealer said.
